mapper.select: SELECT g.group_id, g.group_name, g.owner_user_id, u.nickname AS ownerNickname, g.category_id, c.category_name, l.city, g.created_at, g.group_status FROM ctg_group g JOIN ctg_users u ON g.owner_user_id = u.user_id JOIN ctg_categories c ON g.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN ctg_group_location l ON g.group_id = l.group_id
